title: NASA Invites Media, Public to View Roman Telescope’s First Images
description: NASA will release the first images from its Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope during a live stream from the American Geophysical Union (AGU) Annual Meeting in San Francisco at 3:30 p.m. EST (12:30 p.m. PST) Monday, Dec. 7.
